why: SyntheticInput (moved from CmuxNextApp to CmuxNextCompat) keeps its pending-event list and the buttons synthetic presses hold in one Mutex static, replacing its own pending-list static. The swapped +[NSEvent pressedMouseButtons] getter is a class method with no instance to reach, and the buttons it reports are process-wide like the hardware's; DEBUG and bench builds only register synthetic input.
